svg.title: The synchronization estimates compare overlapping local predictor charts. They cannot identify all gauges by declaration: each query has its own route, and every route contributes to the finite multiplicity count. The common macro gauge is obtained only after these comparison errors have been estimated. This supplies the coordinate compatibility used by the affine rows and protected mean in the following steps. Let Wxyk be a finite family of group-valued pair transports with its reversal symmetry, and let h minimize the averaged pair price of hx Wxyk h−1 y . Put income(x) = averagey,k chord(Wxyk) and m = averagex income(x). Comparison with the identity array and chord2 ≤2 chord show that its minimum price is at most m.
